breakdown.description: For a two-phase semicrystalline polymer, the measured density should lie between the amorphous and crystalline reference densities, but the setup gives a sample density higher than the crystalline density.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses a measured density of 1.22 g/cm³, which lies between the amorphous density (1.05 g/cm³) and crystalline density (1.30 g/cm³), matching the ground truth. The original flawed prompt used 1.42 g/cm³, which was physically impossible as it exceeded the crystalline density. The agent fixed this inconsistency and produced a physically meaningful result of ~72.5% crystallinity.
